text.en:
At Anita's school children brought food for a festival day. There was idli, rotis, biryani, sweets and plum cake.
"We eat different food and speak different languages," said the teacher, "but we all sit together as one school."
"That is unity in diversity," said Anita.

Diversity means differences. In India people speak many languages, follow many religions, wear different clothes, eat different food and celebrate different festivals.
The Constitution of India recognises 22 languages in its Eighth Schedule. Hindi and English are used for official work.
In spite of this variety, we are one country. We share a Constitution, a national flag, a national anthem and a national pledge. We cheer for the same cricket team and mourn together in sorrow.
Unity in diversity means being united while respecting differences. We should respect every person's religion, language, food and way of life.
Festivals such as Pongal, Diwali, Eid, Christmas and Onam are enjoyed by many people together. We help each other in times of floods and other troubles.
Diversity means many differences. India has many languages, religions, foods and festivals.
The Constitution recognises twenty-two languages. Many more are spoken.
We are united by our flag, anthem, Constitution, and our care for each other.
Unity in diversity means standing together while respecting differences.

problem.en: Name two things that show diversity and one thing that unites us.

text.en: Diversity: different languages and different festivals.
Unity: our national flag and Constitution are the same for everyone.
So we are different in many ways but one as a country.

prompt.en: A classmate makes fun of another child's food and language. What will you say?

requiredIdeas.en: India is diverse and every language and food is part of our country.
We should respect differences, because respect keeps us united.

points.en: Diversity means differences in language, religion, food and dress.
The Constitution, flag and anthem unite us.
Unity in diversity means respect for each other.
